english.note: Use 流出 when blood or another liquid is specifically coming out of a wound, container, or other opening.
Use this when liquid or another substance flows out from a source.

examples.english: Blood continued to stream out of their wound.
examples.traditional: 佢個傷口仲有血流出嚟。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 go3 soeng1 hau2 zung6 jau5 hyut3 lau4 ceot1 lei4

examples.english: The issue is that water is flowing out of the bottle.
examples.traditional: 個問題係樽入面啲水流出嚟。
examples.jyutping: go3 man6 tai4 hai6 zeon1 jap6 min6 di1 seoi2 lau4 ceot1 lei4
